title: SourceRef
description: Canonical structured provenance reference from a claim to a source record. source_id and locator are required: locator is the concrete pointer (url, path, key, or stable id) captured at extraction time. Plain string references and sourceId are deprecated; normalizers convert them to this shape, emit a deprecation finding, and flag the missing locator. Timeline Truth provenance fields (heading, tableRow, line, text) locate the evidence inside the source and are optional passthrough metadata.

source_id.description: Identifier of a source record that exists in the same artifact.

locator.description: Concrete pointer to the evidence (URL, path, key, or stable id) captured at extraction time. Missing on reviewed/extracted claims is at least needs_review.

note.description: Optional human note about what the source supports.

path.description: Optional file path captured at extraction time.

url.description: Optional absolute HTTP(S) URL captured at extraction time.

observed_at.description: When the evidence was observed, as a full RFC3339 datetime with Z or UTC offset.

source_updated_at.description: Last-modified time reported by the source system, as a full RFC3339 datetime with Z or UTC offset.

revision.description: Optional revision of the source at extraction time.

content_hash.description: Optional sha256 content hash in canonical 64-hex form, with or without a sha256: prefix.

heading.description: Timeline Truth provenance: section heading inside the source that contains the evidence.

tableRow.description: Timeline Truth provenance: 1-based row of the table inside the source that contains the evidence.

line.description: Timeline Truth provenance: 1-based line number inside the source that contains the evidence.

text.description: Timeline Truth provenance: verbatim text quoted at extraction time.
